{{Quote|Informants have told us that the populace of Rintonne is not yet aware of the fall of the Empire and the rise of the New Republic. Tount's control of information is so great that he is able to enslave a whole population through fear alone.|General Airen Cracken, New Republic|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Rintonne''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]. A member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Rintonne was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rasit Brun]], the [[Senator/Legends|sectorial Senator]] representing Lambda in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Par Lankin]] installed a planetary [[Governor/Legends|Governor]], [[Serdif Tount]], to rule over Rintonne. Tount restricted the natives' freedom and for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prevented them from discovering that the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] had died in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Circa [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the whole sector stopped being the fiefdom of an Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].

==Description==
Rintonne was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EA" /> It was relatively close to [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]],<ref name="EA" /> and neighboring the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]].<ref name="HNN" />

==History==
{{Quote|This is nothing short of an open act of warfare. I would ask the Senator representing the Trade Federation if he would agree with my perception that somebody somewhere is making a profit here by arming our Aqualish neighbors.|Senator Rasit Brun of Lambda sector|<ref name="HNN" />}}
The planet Rintonne was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and joined it at some point between [[3000 BBY|3000]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], during a period of explorations.<ref name="EA" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of Rintonne, [[Rasit Brun]], had become the [[Senator/Legends|Galactic Senator]] representing the whole Lambda sector before the Republic during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rintonne remained a part of the Republic instead of joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EA" />

After the end of the war, Rintonne became a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under the command of [[Par Lankin]], the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Lambda sector.<ref name="WBC" /> Over the years of Galactic Empire rule, the population of Rintonne suffered from the systematic denial of basic rights. When the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rintonne had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The planet resisted the advances of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[6 ABY/Legends|two]] following years.<ref name="EA" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], undercover agents of [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] studied the situation on Rintonne. By then, Moff Lankin had handed over the planet to his subordinate [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Serdif Tount]], providing him with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] to keep control over the planet. Tount did so by restricting the freedom of the civilian population and their access to information, as well as by monitoring incoming traffic.<ref name="WBC" /> Tount was believed to have hired former [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] specialist [[Victor Grieves]], because Grieves had been seen in the Rintonne system.<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> Cracken's [[Spy/Legends|spies]] discovered that the inhabitants of Rintonne did not even know about the fall of the Empire and the creation of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They also lacked the value to rebel against Tount because the could not see any hope of victory. However, Cracken's analysts believed that, if the New Republic could take over Rintonne, the victory could motivate other planets in the sector to rebel against Lankin.<ref name="WBC" />

Soon afterward, the whole Lambda sector, including Rintonne, stopped being Lankin's personal fiefdom. By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of Rintonne was of several billion people. In [[127 ABY]], Rintonne was in the area of the galaxy controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|the Sith Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rintonne was first mentioned in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] ([[1993]]), published by [[West End Games]].
